Meta.title: Meridian Bank
Meta.description: Modern multi-currency digital banking. Hold, convert, and transfer funds globally with confidence.

Home.title: One account for dollars and won.
Home.subtitle: Hold, send and convert USD and KRW instantly, with a clear ledger behind every cent.

wallets.title: Multi-currency wallets
wallets.body: Hold USD and KRW side by side with correct decimals and formatting for each.

transfers.title: Instant transfers
transfers.body: Send money to anyone on Meridian by account number. Every transfer is idempotent and audited.

history.title: Honest transaction history
history.body: Every balance is the sum of a double-entry ledger, exportable any time.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Freeze your account in one tap and review every sign-in and action.

security.title: Built with security first
security.body: Argon2 password hashing, two-factor authentication, strict security headers and an append-only audit log.

Dashboard.comingSoon: Wallets and transactions arrive in the next phase.

Admin.title: Admin panel
Admin.subtitle: Only administrators can adjust balances or change account status. Every action needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
Admin.selfNote: You cannot change your own account. Ask another administrator.

adjust.reasonHint: Shown on the customer's history and saved in the audit log.

Convert.title: Wallets and currency conversion
Convert.subtitle: Hold money in up to 8 currencies and convert between your own wallets. Meridian keeps a {spread}% margin on the exchange rate.
Convert.needTwo: Open a second wallet to convert between currencies.
Convert.allOpen: You have a wallet in every supported currency.

form.title: Convert money
form.hint: The rate shown on this page is today's rate. Your wallet is charged immediately and the converted amount is credited at once.

open.title: Open another wallet
open.hint: Each wallet has its own account number. It starts at zero.

rates.title: Today's customer rates
rates.live: Live market rate minus Meridian's margin.
rates.fallback: Approximate rates (the live rate service could not be reached).

Cards.title: Virtual cards
Cards.subtitle: Create virtual cards linked to your wallets, manage spending limits, and freeze them at any time.

purchase.title: Card purchase
purchase.hint: Authorize and process a transaction against this card's ledger balance.

Cards.limitReached: You can have up to {max} active cards, or you have no wallet yet.

create.title: Create a card
create.hint: The card uses this wallet's balance.
create.shownOnce: Copy these details now. For safety, only the last 4 digits are kept.

Loans.title: Loans
Loans.subtitle: Apply for a personal loan. An administrator reviews your application, approved funds are credited to your wallet, and you repay in monthly instalments.
Loans.oneAtATime: You can only have one pending or active loan at a time.

apply.title: Apply for a loan
apply.hint: Longer terms have a higher rate. Maximum amounts depend on the currency.

Requests.title: Payment requests
Requests.subtitle: Ask another Meridian customer for money, or pay and decline requests sent to you.
Requests.noneIncoming: Nobody has requested money from you.
Requests.noneOutgoing: You have not requested money yet.

External.title: Bank transfer
External.subtitle: Send money to an account at another bank. The money leaves your wallet now and is confirmed by an administrator. If rejected, you are refunded.

form.title: New bank transfer
form.name: Recipient name
form.hint: A small fee applies (0.5%, minimum one unit of the currency).

Crypto.title: Digital assets
Crypto.subtitle: Buy and sell digital assets directly with your USD wallet balance.
Crypto.fallbackPrices: Showing estimated rates (the live price service could not be reached).

buy.title: Buy
buy.hint: Coins are rounded down to 8 decimal places.

Queue.title: Approvals
Queue.subtitle: Loan applications, bank transfers and cards that need an administrator.

dormancy.title: Dormant accounts
dormancy.hint: Wallets with no activity for 180 days become Dormant. They reactivate when the customer signs in again.
